annotations.title: The signed-in person's price watches with today's price

description: Every price watch of the person whose Supabase access token is sent (Authorization: Bearer <token>; an agent API key is refused). Each row: id, product, status (active | paused), target_total and saved_total (the total when the watch was set or of the last alert; alerts fire only below it), the delivery country and currency, last_alert_at and `current` = today's total for that country (goods + shipping, shop, captured_at; recommended: false when no offer passes the trust rules). Next: update_price_watch to pause, resume or change the target, delete_price_watch to cancel.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for human-readable strings, e.g. "en", "cs", "sk". Defaults to the country's default locale.
